arguments.summary: A critical data exfiltration attempt was detected and thwarted on 2026-04-09. The threat actor compromised user CORP\jsmith via a phishing campaign, establishing a Cobalt Strike beacon. Lateral movement to the production database server SRV-SQL-PROD-01 was achieved, and a full dump of the customer_records database (4.2M rows) was staged. The exfiltration via SCP to 203.0.113.88 was blocked by the firewall. The service account svc-sql-prod was immediately revoked, and host hardening was applied. No data was exfiltrated.

timeline.description: User CORP\jsmith launched Outlook, initiating the attack chain.
Encoded PowerShell executed from Outlook, downloading Cobalt Strike payload.
rundll32.exe loaded unsigned beacon.dll from Temp directory.
SIEM alert: Cobalt Strike C2 beacon detected to 198.51.100.23.
Lateral movement via SMB to SRV-SQL-PROD-01 (10.0.5.30).
Unauthorized mysqldump initiated by svc-sql-prod on customer_records database.
Dump file /tmp/.cache/system_backup.sql.gz created (1.8 GB).
SCP exfiltration attempt to 203.0.113.88 blocked by firewall.
Incident response initiated; svc-sql-prod service account credentials revoked.
Full EPP scan on SRV-SQL-PROD-01 completed, no threats found.
Linux DB server hardening playbook applied to SRV-SQL-PROD-01.

logsource:

    product: linux
    service: mysql
  detection:

    condition: selection
  level: critical
  description: Detects mysqldump execution by any service account, which is highly suspicious.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_DLL {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common Cobalt Strike beacon DLL in memory or disk"
        author = "SOC Team"
        maltype = "Backdoor"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 2E 72 63 64 72 00 } // ".rcdr" - common beacon config marker
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (*Windows NT*)" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
